Subject: Redwood marketplace listing — bill-to / PO setup info

Hi Naomi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough yesterday. We're excited to get the CloudNexus listing live on Redwood's marketplace. To unblock our finance team, they asked for a concise list of what you need from us to activate the "bill-to"/PO flow across AWS and GCP.

Attached you'll find our onboarding packet and the W-9. Key asks from our side:
- Confirm which billing entity Redwood will bill (bill-to vs. payor mapping).
- PO number format and where to send the official PO.
- Any required tax/VAT evidence for EU-facing listings.
- Integration test plan for metering & invoice reconciliation (see attachment).

We can sign a minimal SOW if needed. For speed, we've attached a signed MSA (redlined items were resolved). Also included: integration_test_plan.xlsx.

Can you confirm the next steps and an estimated timeline for PO activation?

Thanks,
Olivia Chen
Head of Partnerships | CloudNexus
olivia.chen@cloudnexus.io
+1 (415) 555-0182

Hi Olivia — thanks for the packet, and appreciate the clear checklist. Looping in Vanessa (Marketplace Ops), Ben (FinOps/procurement), and Kimberly (Legal) to confirm internal owners and next steps.

Short plan from our side:
1) Ben will confirm payor mapping and provide the PO ingestion endpoint and required fields (PO number format, lead time for activation).
2) Vanessa will validate the integration test plan and schedule a short sandbox verification window with our infra team.
3) Kimberly will confirm the MSA acceptance and flag any residual SOW gaps.
4) Once the bill-to/payor mapping is approved and we have a signed PO, we can flip the billing switch for AWS/GCP listings (usually 3 business days).

Ben/Kimberly/Vanessa — can you confirm ETA for your pieces? Olivia — can you ask your procurement contact to send the formal PO to procurement@cloudnexus.io and cc me so Ben can map the account?

Best,
Naomi Feldman

Naomi / team — quick thread to confirm procurement mechanics.

Summary of what I need from CloudNexus to create the bill-to mapping and accept POs:
- Legal entity name exactly as it should appear on invoices.
- Billing address and remit-to (if different).
- Tax ID / VAT registration number (we have W-9).
- Preferred PO number format (prefix + numeric length).
- Contact for invoice disputes (name + email).

Our operational notes:
- PO ingestion endpoint: invoices@redwood-invoices.com (send PDF + embed PO number in subject).
- Typical activation after first valid PO: 48–72 hours to map and enable automated billing for AWS/GCP marketplace listings.
- If they need consolidated monthly invoicing for multiple marketplace sales, we'll need to set up consolidated invoicing — add a 7–10 business day lead time.

Action items assigned:
- Olivia: send the formal PO to invoices@redwood-invoices.com and CC naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com.
- Vanessa: schedule sandbox verification with vendor and share test login.
- Kimberly: quick read of the attached MSA and flag anything blocking PO acceptance.

Thanks — a couple infra/ops notes from my side:

- Integration test plan looks reasonable. I'll own the sandbox run and will book a 60-minute session with CloudNexus engineers for Monday 12/13 at 10am PT (proposed). Please confirm availability.
- We need a test seller account and a sample SKU to exercise metering; Olivia, can you provide a test SKU and an API key with limited scope?
- For AWS/GCP marketplace, billing flows differ slightly: for AWS we rely on their marketplace billing receipts (we map AWS invoice line items to CloudNexus SKUs). For GCP we pull usage records via the partner reporting API. Please confirm whether CloudNexus will provide a single consolidated PO or separate POs per marketplace.
- Timeline estimate: sandbox verification + PO mapping = 3 business days from receipt of a correct PO. Production flip can be scheduled after we confirm one successful test invoice reconciliation.

Vanessa Ortiz
